chunks: Sufficient is Allah and His Word as perfection.

key_terms.لِلْمُتَّقِينَ: for the God-conscious / for the pious

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah and His Word are sufficient for the perfection of the pious?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this hadith to anchor the doctrine of *Ghaybah* and divine preservation, asserting that Allah’s Word remains the ultimate source of perfection for the *Muttaqin* even during periods of occultation. This establishes the theological continuity of guidance, reinforcing that the pious are not left orphaned but are sustained by the sufficiency of divine revelation and promise. It serves as a foundational proof for the enduring authority of the Imams as the carriers of this Word.
